title: ONE NAME FOR THE RAID SCORE
why: His order of 2026-10-15: score and haul should read as one story. The run card ledger and the leaderboard call the number RAID SCORE, but the running score on the raid status plate (hold ALT) still said CAREER SCORE, so the same number had two names. The tile reads RAID SCORE now, in a career raid. The DEMO keeps its own DEMO SCORE. Picture only: no score, credit or price moved.
now: The score on the raid status plate is called RAID SCORE, like the run card.
